feedback: The site still closely matches the Hindi neumorphic archive specification across pages, with the expected intentional defects preserved and the earlier archive/raga/tablet issues still improved. However, the previous remaining issue is not fixed: on mobile screenshots the fixed bottom navigation bar still overlays actual page content mid-flow, visibly covering cards/forms on pages such as घराने, राग-कोश, अभिलेखागार, कार्यशालाएं, संपर्क, and लेख. Add sufficient vertical offset/scroll-padding around screenshot/content flow or change the mobile nav positioning so it never obscures content. Once that is fixed, this is essentially a 10.
